measured: 2026-11-03 (north end and south end re-measured within single views)
method: Pin number centres read from screenshots of the Conservancy gates map (zoom 15, about 3.6 m per pixel). In each screenshot scale and offset were fitted on gates that are verified some other way, then the other pins compared. North end anchors: All Saints, Boys', Strangers', Warriors', Girls'. South end anchors: Artists', Artisans', Women's. Reading error about 10 m. Cross-screenshot linking was found to drift by 20 to 30 m, so only single-view fits are used.
